note: Official turn counts for the circuits in Le Mans Ultimate, read once from the game's own site (lemansultimate.com/circuits) and stored here: the app never goes online. Used to check (and gently correct) the turns found from your laps. 'confidence': high = the official site gives this figure for this layout, so the app may fix its own turn list toward it; medium = from other sources, so the count is only shown. 'length_m' is the lap length: an entry is only used when your lap is within 4% of it, and when two entries fit, the closer one wins. 'named_corners_mentioned' are corner names the site gives without turn numbers (not used yet). 'names' (turn-by-turn names) exist only where the numbering is known to be right. Add or correct entries freely. 'map' links an entry to its layout drawing in data/track_maps/ (see CREDITS.md there).
